 (Madhya Pradesh)

 And
 State Of Madhya Pradesh Through Police
 Station Tala District Satna (Madhya Pradesh)
 ..
 (By Shri - Pankaj Tiwari - Panel Lawyer For The State)
 (By Shri Pradeep Patel - Advocate For The Objector)

This application coming on for admission this day, the c
 following:
 Order

This application has been filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. for grant of regular bail relating to Crime No.337/2023 registered at Police Station- Tala, District Satna (M.P.) for commission of offence under Sections 376, 506of IPC.
Applicant is in custody since 20.11.2023.

2. As per the prosecution story, in short, is that FIR was lodged by the complainant on 23.10.2023 at Police Station Tala, District Satna (M.P.) against the applicant alleging that applicant has committed rape with her when she was alone at her house.
He also threatened her if she discloses the incident to anybody then he will kill her and also her child.
3 . Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the crime in question.
Prosecutrix is a major, aged about 24 years.
She is married lady having one children.
They were in relationship.
FIR has been lodged belatedly i.e. after 25 days of the incident.
Charge sheet has been filed.
FSL report is also available on record and it is negative.
The trial would take considerable time, therefore, it is prayed that the applicant be granted bail.

sentences.text:
On the other hand, learned counsel for the State has opposed grant of bail to the applicant and submits that there is one criminal case under Section 323 of IPC registered against the present application in the year 2015.
5.
Having taken into consideration all the facts and circumstances of the case, but without commenting upon merits of the case, I am inclined to release the applicant on bail.

Consequently,
this bail application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed.

6 . I t is directed that applicant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.

He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
7 .
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case o f bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
